description: Booking-platform registry for the find skill's Booking mode golden check: a Google Business Profile whose website field points at one of these platforms' business-page URL shapes is a pre-qualified booking-mode lead. Consumed by scripts/booking-check.js. Region tags are prioritisation hints, not match filters (a URL match is a URL match anywhere).

classifications.standard: normal qualifier — a platform URL in the GBP website field pre-qualifies the lead
classifications.weak_embed_first: platform primarily embeds booking on the business's OWN site, so a platform-hosted URL in GBP is rare/weak; still match but flag (Boulevard, Mangomint, bsport, Phorest-partial)
classifications.aggregator_exclude: marketplace/aggregator, not the business's booking backend; NEVER the golden-check qualifier (ClassPass, Urban Sports Club, Secret Spa)
classifications.disqualifier: always paying but wrong ICP — enterprise/chains (Zenoti); do not pitch
classifications.dead_platform: platform is defunct; a GBP link here = broken web presence = PREMIUM lead (FitogramPro)
classifications.has_website: the lead HAS a website (platform builds full sites); classify as has-website, not booking-as-website (Wix Bookings)

fee_line_legend.true: safe to pitch 'you're paying this platform (subscription and/or commission)'
fee_line_legend.false: a genuine free tier or reverse-payment exists; a fee-saving pitch can be factually wrong — pitch professionalism/ownership instead
fee_line_legend.conditional: fee line depends on a per-lead content check (e.g. paid classes visible) or is commission-only with human review

matcher_rules: Unwrap social redirect wrappers before matching: instagram.com/linkshim/?u={enc}, l.facebook.com/l.php?u={enc}, lm.facebook.com — decode the u= param and classify the TARGET URL (validation found a square.site behind a linkshim misclassified as social_only).

platforms.name: Fresha

fingerprints.note: claimed, bookable, PAYING partner page: /a/{name-location-street}-{8-char LOWERCASE id}. Locale prefixes (/en-GB/a/, /it/a/) seen in UK/IE evidence though unprefixed is canonical and curl-404s prefixes (bot-block caveat)
direct booking flow of a claimed profile; may end /booking/offline for lapsed partners

Link-Builder share link — live 2026 form is /book-now/{slug}-{8char-id}/all-offer?pId=… (validated Miami+London 2026-07-18, 3 live URLs); older /services?lid= form also covered. Always a paying partner.
Fresha-owned AU marketplace (acquired Feb 2022) — treat as Fresha-family

exclude_fingerprints.note: UNCLAIMED community listing (/lvp/{slug}-{6-char MIXED-case id}); page explicitly disclaims Fresha affiliation, no online booking. MUST NOT COUNT as a paying lead — but IS the strongest 'no bookable website at all' signal. ID tell: /a/=8 lowercase, /lvp/=6 mixed-case ID length widened to 5-8 chars: live Dublin /lvp/ URL (proper-fresh-bond-street-yKVNo) carries a 5-char ID.

pricing_summary.commission: 20% one-time new-client marketplace fee (min $6/£4/€6) + card processing (~1.19-2.79%)

platforms.fee_line_notes: FREE TIER DIED early 2025 (triple-verified) — any pre-2025 'Fresha is free' logic is stale/inverted. Now subscription + 20% new-client commission on marketplace-discovered clients (exactly the traffic a GBP link creates). Caveat: some legacy accounts grandfathered free — usually true, verify per lead where possible. /lvp/ pages are NOT paying (see exclude).
platforms.prominence: very high — the #1 booking-platform GBP fingerprint across UK/IE/EU/AU/NZ; strong US/CA

alternate hosted booking host

pricing_summary.AU: Free A$0 / Plus A$40 / Premium A$90 per location

platforms.fee_line_notes: Real, indefinite free tier is the micro-business norm (a *.square.site subdomain specifically signals the FREE Square Online plan). Fee pitch can be false. Processing fees always apply but that is not a booking-software subscription. Pitch ownership/professionalism.
